| description = Merchant selling plate armor. Wife of [[Ton Firepride]] who is a rival of [[Brohan Ironforge]]. Lanhern swoons over Brohan's son [[Dren Ironforge]]. Dren believes Lanhern's husband Ton is her father. Lanhern claims Ton was tutored  in [[Blacksmithing]] by the [[Dwarf |Dwarfs]] of [[Kaladim]] ... and she also acquired the dwarf's love of drink. [[Ogre Swill]] is her beverage of choice. The Firepride's son is [[Guard Ginton]] who patrols North Qeynos.

She goes to the Fish's Ale at -231, -280 from 6PM to 6AM and will not sell anything during this timeframe. [[Meera Lylon]] takes her place in Fireprides to sell the same selection.
